grounding.from: Ratehub says as of October 12, 2026, the lowest high-ratio 5-year fixed rate is 4.34%; WOWA, as of Oct 9, says the lowest 5-year fixed insured rate is 4.34%
WOWA, as of Oct 9, says the lowest 5-year fixed conventional rate is 4.44%
nesto's Oct 9 page lists a Big 6 Bank average 5-year fixed of 5.17%; BMO raised its standard 5-year fixed rate to 5.14% on October 7

grounding.states: rates are climbing again this month
grounding.from: Fixed rates are climbing again in October 2026, after all 6 of the largest banks raised select fixed rates since early September
The question doesn't say whether the mortgage is insured (under 20% down), insurable, or uninsured

value.answer: Lowest 5-year fixed in Canada right now is about 4.34% for insured mortgages (Ratehub and WOWA, as of Oct 9-12). Conventional lowest is around 4.44%, and the big banks are more like 5.14-5.17%. Rates are climbing again this month. Is your mortgage insured (under 20% down) or uninsured?
